typical_streaming_sequence: 1. Controller begins driving continuous SCK at the agreed bit rate (sample_rate × channels × bits_per_sample).
2. Controller toggles WS to mark channel boundaries: WS=0 (left), WS=1 (right), alternating each word.
3. WS transition occurs on the SCK edge that the controller chooses (either edge is OK; receiver latches on leading edge).
4. ONE SCK period after the WS transition, transmitter drives the MSB of the next channel's word on SD.
5. Subsequent bits MSB-1, MSB-2, ..., LSB are driven on each successive SCK period.
6. Receiver latches SD on each leading (LOW-to-HIGH) edge of SCK; combined with the latched WS, it reconstructs left/right channel words.

word_length_mismatch_sequences.scenario: Transmitter word SHORTER than receiver word
word_length_mismatch_sequences.behavior: Transmitter sends MSB→LSB of its short word; remaining bits (until receiver's LSB position) are sent as zeros. Receiver fills missing LSBs internally as zero.

word_length_mismatch_sequences.scenario: Transmitter word LONGER than receiver word
word_length_mismatch_sequences.behavior: Transmitter sends MSB→LSB of its long word; receiver latches only up to its internal word length and ignores extra bits beyond LSB position.

configuration_handover_sequences.name: Transmitter-as-Controller
configuration_handover_sequences.steps: Transmitter generates SCK + WS + SD. Receiver synchronizes to incoming clock; no handshake needed.

configuration_handover_sequences.name: Receiver-as-Controller
configuration_handover_sequences.steps: Receiver generates SCK + WS. Transmitter receives external SCK + WS and drives SD synchronized to them.

configuration_handover_sequences.name: System-Controller
configuration_handover_sequences.steps: Separate IC generates SCK + WS. Both transmitter and receiver are targets; transmitter drives SD under external clock.

stream_halt_sequence: 1. Controller stops toggling SCK (e.g. gates clock off).
2. SD level becomes don't-care; receivers stay in their last-latched state.
3. To resume: controller restarts SCK + WS; receiver re-synchronizes on first WS edge.
